title: The weave is too loose
text: The weave is too loose. This throw is very pretty to throw over a chair, but the weave is impractical for every day use....especially with children or pets.  It will snag and tear easily. Those are my fingers behind the blanket in the picture. I wouldn't buy again or give as a gift.
